reports.title: CENTRAL GARDEN & PET REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS AND PROVIDES FISCAL 2027 OUTLOOK

guidance.heading: Outlook for Fiscal 2027
section: Central currently expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better. The outlook reflects a prudent view of current market conditions and continued investments to support long-term growth. It also anticipates a challenging first quarter, with opportunities for improvement as the year progresses.

The outlook includes Burpee, acquired on September 30, 2026, and TRIXIE, which is expected to close in the second quarter of fiscal 2027. Purchase accounting is expected to have a meaningful impact on both acquisitions in fiscal 2027, resulting in a minimal contribution to EPS. Central expects a more meaningful EPS contribution in fiscal 2028 as these impacts moderate.
Capital spending is projected at approximately $50 million, focused on maintenance, productivity, and targeted growth initiatives across both segments.
This outlook excludes the impact of any other acquisitions, divestitures or restructuring activities that may occur during fiscal 2027 and any further tariffs.

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 (quarter to 26 Sep 2026); full year fiscal 2026
desk.headline: Q4 sales down 21% to $537m, below estimates; adjusted loss of $0.04 a share, smaller than expected; FY27 EPS outlook of $2.65+ below forecasts

other.label: Diluted EPS (GAAP)
other.change: vs -$0.16 a year ago, helped by tariff refunds

results: Q4 sales fell 21% to $537m, below the $607m estimate, mainly because the pet distribution business was exited; organic sales fell 6%.
Pet organic sales fell 5% on softer demand, lost pet-bed distribution and a supply constraint; Garden sales fell 7% on poor weather for live plants.
The adjusted loss narrowed to $0.04 a share from $0.09; GAAP profit of $0.19 a share included $20m of tariff refunds.
For the full year, organic sales rose 1%, adjusted gross margin widened 150 bps to 33.6% and adjusted EPS hit a record $3.00.
Cash reached $1.09bn with no credit-line borrowings; Burpee was bought after year end and a deal for 80% of Europe's TRIXIE awaits closing.

guidance.summary: Central expects fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS of $2.65 or better, below this year's $3.00 and the $3.09 analyst forecast cited by Investing.com. It flags a hard first quarter and little EPS help from Burpee and TRIXIE this year because of purchase accounting.

points: Management said overall pet demand is stable, with shoppers still looking for value.
Q1 is expected to show an adjusted loss of $0.10–0.15 a share, hit by Burpee's seasonal losses, high retailer stock, fuel costs and partnership start-up losses.
The TRIXIE deal is expected to close around March, funded from cash; the CEO said the earn-out is not all-or-nothing.
Acquisitions remain the first use of cash, with leverage of 2.6x well under the 3.0–3.5x target.

watch: Size of the Q1 loss and whether trading improves into the spring garden season.
Closing and early results of the TRIXIE acquisition and Burpee integration.
Losses at the new pet distribution partnership and any further tariff changes.
